verdict.rationale: Shortwave documents triggers that run on incoming email to draft replies, add team comments, organize threads into todos, and connect to other apps. It also offers custom AI filters that automatically label, star, and archive mail using rules written in plain English. Evidence is limited to marketing and changelog snippets. Missing for 10: in-depth docs on trigger/rule configuration and supported event types beyond email arrival, documentation of rule limits or ordering, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can define rules that trigger actions automatically on events

citations.quote: Set up triggers to draft replies when emails arrive, add comments for your team, organize threads into todos, and connect to 3,000+ other apps.
Take control of your inbox with custom AI filters. Automatically label, star, archive, and more with scripts you write in plain English.
